content.title: ARK’s Cathie Wood Is Betting on a Crypto Stock Rebound. Here’s What She Bought.
content.summary: Crypto stocks are on a terrible run but  Cathie Wood is intent on buying the dip.  Wood’s ARK funds loaded up on almost $50 million worth of shares in crypto-exposed companies, including crypto exchange  Coinbase  Ethereum treasury company  Bitmine Immersion Technologies  stablecoin issuer  Circle Internet Group  and CoinDesk owner  Bullish  according to a trade notification Monday.  Coinbase stock fell more than 6%, while Circle tumbled 9.6%, Bitmine plunged 11% and Bullish slipped 2.6%.
